name: 90066 · Los Angeles, CA
findings: ZIP 90066 (Los Angeles) has 197 nonprofit organizations. 69 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 58 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90066 (Los Angeles) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 20 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do foundation organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 90066 (Los Angeles) list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
